sessions.title: Doors Open · Food, Drinks & Arrivals
sessions.abstract: Doors open at 16:45 inside Wales Millennium Centre's Dance House | Tŷ Dawns. Check in with your Eventbrite QR ticket, enjoy food & drinks, explore the 5th Anniversary visual wall, and settle in before the screening.

sessions.title: 5th Anniversary Welcome: Impact Through Dance & Culture
sessions.abstract: AFJ Cardiff opens the evening, reflecting on five years of community classes, showcases, and cultural work in Cardiff leading up to the documentary project.

sessions.title: 'Movement as Memory' — Exclusive Documentary Premiere
sessions.abstract: First public screening of AFJ Cardiff's original documentary on Afro dance beyond the trends—tracing roots, history, and cultural transmission across generations and communities.

sessions.title: Panel Talk: Afro Dance Beyond the Trends
sessions.abstract: A live conversation unpacking the film's central questions: how movement carries memory, why lineage and naming matter in viral dance culture, and what it takes to pass traditions forward.

sessions.title: Intermission · Food, Drinks & Community Exchange
sessions.abstract: Step back into the foyer for refreshments, food & drinks, and conversation with fellow guests, dancers, filmmakers, and community partners.

sessions.title: Live Performances · 5th Anniversary Showcase
sessions.abstract: Live Afro dance performances bringing the documentary's themes to life on the Dance House | Tŷ Dawns stage with rhythm, ensemble choreography, and celebration.

sessions.title: Fashion Show · Heritage & Contemporary Silhouette
sessions.abstract: A curated fashion show celebrating African and diaspora design, bold textile craft, and cultural expression on the runway.

sessions.title: Closing Circle & 5th Anniversary Finale
sessions.abstract: Final reflections, acknowledgements to community partners, and an open celebratory close at 20:30.

speakers.name: AFJ Cardiff
speakers.bio: Celebrating five years in Cardiff, AFJ Cardiff builds community through Afro dance workshops, storytelling, cultural exchange, and youth empowerment across Wales. 'Movement as Memory' marks a milestone archive of the movement and the people carrying it forward.

speakers.name: 'Movement as Memory'
speakers.bio: An original documentary on Afro dance beyond the trends: examining roots, history, and cultural transmission across generations, studios, and diaspora communities. Premiering exclusively for AFJ Cardiff's 5th Anniversary.

speakers.name: Panel Talk
speakers.bio: Following the screening, a live panel talk unpacks the origins behind trending choreography, the responsibility of credit and lineage, and how Afro dance preserves living memory in Cardiff and beyond.

speakers.name: Live Performances
speakers.bio: High-energy live performances celebrating the breadth of Afro dance styles—connecting traditional rhythms, contemporary choreography, and the Cardiff dance community on the Dance House stage.

speakers.name: Fashion & Hospitality
speakers.bio: An anniversary evening bringing textile heritage, bold contemporary runway silhouettes, and warm food & drinks together—turning the Dance House foyer and stage into a shared space of celebration.

faq.q: How do I book official tickets?
faq.a: Tickets are hosted via Eventbrite (Organiser: AFJ Cardiff). Scan the QR code in the official poster section on this site, or use the interactive planner on this page to preview ticket tiers and reach the Eventbrite organiser listing.

faq.q: What are the door and programme times?
faq.a: Doors open at 16:45 on Saturday 5th December. The main programme runs from 17:30 to 20:30 at Dance House | Tŷ Dawns, Wales Millennium Centre.
Both Early Bird (£15) and General Admission (£20) cover the exclusive premiere of 'Movement as Memory', the live panel talk, live performances, fashion show, and access to food & drinks.
Dance House | Tŷ Dawns is inside the Wales Millennium Centre, Pierhead St, Cardiff CF10 4PH (Cardiff Bay), easily reached via Cardiff Bay rail station or Cardiff Central.
Yes. Wales Millennium Centre and Dance House | Tŷ Dawns offer step-free access, lifts to all levels, accessible seating, and a hearing loop.

faq.q: Who do I contact for enquiries or group bookings?
faq.a: Email afjcardiff@gmail.com for press, community partnerships, accessibility requests, or general enquiries.
